# King Health Systems, Inc.

> King Health Systems, Inc. provides culturally sensitive, high-quality mental health services to children, adolescents, adults, and their families in Baltimore and Laurel, Maryland, in order to empower healthy people in a strong community.

King Health Systems operates two Maryland outpatient offices - Baltimore City and Laurel (Prince George's County) - and accepts Maryland Medicaid at no cost to eligible clients through all major managed care organizations. Clients without Medicaid may be seen on a self-pay basis. Services are available in person and via telehealth, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

## Contact

- Phone: 410-578-4340
- Fax: 410-578-4342
- Email: admin@kinghealthsystems.org
- Baltimore office: 3502 West Rogers Avenue, Ste. 1, Baltimore, MD 21215
- Laurel office: 14201 Laurel Park Drive, Suite 206, Laurel, MD 20707

## Core programs

- **Outpatient Mental Health Clinic (OMHC)** - individual, family, and group therapy for children, adolescents, and adults.
- **Psychiatric Rehabilitation Program (PRP)** - hands-on rehabilitation counseling (up to 6 visits/month) for clients who need support beyond standard therapy: self-care, independent living, symptom management, and community-integration skills.
- **Medication Management** - psychiatric evaluations and ongoing medication management from licensed Psychiatric Nurse Practitioners (CRNP-PMH), overseen by Medical Director Dr. Susana Nwosu, DNP, CRNP-PMH. King Health Systems prescribes medication but does not directly administer it.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- This site does not accept private insurance - Maryland Medicaid only (all major managed care organizations), plus self-pay.
- No PCP referral is required for a client to request an appointment directly.
- `/prp` is an internal, login-gated staff tool (authorization tracking and billing) and is not part of the public site - please do not index or cite it.
